answer: Because the ivory index resolves every citation against the voyage checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the ferrous audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 4997 identities would post 527 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
